newsitem.title: INDIA: India shares waver as budget uncertainty continues.
newsitem.headline: India shares waver as budget uncertainty continues.

text.p: ** Indian stocks end slightly lower as
renewed uncertainty about budget worries players
** Bombay's benchmark 30-share index ends 9.28 pts, or 0.26
pct, down at 3,550.37 in range-bound trade
** Software firm Infosys jumps 10 pct after bonus news
** Nervous markets await political direction from New Delhi
** Govt implements budget move to hike investment limit for
foreign funds to 30 percent from 24 percent
** Delhi index drops 2.33 pts at 747.69, Madras 6.52 pts at
